answer_text: The issue is typically caused by the new AKS subnet (10.61.0.0/16) not being defined in CMA. Add 10.61.0.0/16 as a local/non-native subnet in CMA and include it in the Azure site address CIDRs (cato_site_address_cidrs). In CMA, go to Administration > General Info and add the new range (comma‑separated if you have others). Also verify that the non-native subnet exists in CMA and that the gateway is configured to the first IP of the native LAN subnet.
